summary_en: AFC-HD agreed to acquire all shares of Saikaya through a stock exchange, making Saikaya a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction is scheduled to close on December 15, 2026, after obtaining Saikaya shareholders' approval on November 16, 2026, with delisting on December 11, 2026. The exchange ratio was determined based on third-party valuations considering Saikaya's earnings capacity, financial condition, real estate assets, and market price.
title_en: Notice of Execution of Stock Exchange Agreement Regarding Complete Subsidiary Status of Saikaya by AFC-HD AMS Life Science Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
AFC-HD AMS Life Science Co., Ltd. has agreed to acquire all outstanding shares of Saikaya Co., Ltd. through a stock exchange, making Saikaya a wholly owned subsidiary of AFC-HD. AFC-HD and Saikaya have maintained capital and business relationships, with Saikaya already consolidated as a subsidiary of AFC-HD. However, Saikaya was scheduled for delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange on September 16, 2026.

The stock exchange will close on December 15, 2026, following approval by Saikaya shareholders at an ordinary general meeting scheduled for November 16, 2026. Saikaya will be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 11, 2026. AFC-HD will not require shareholder approval as the transaction qualifies as a simplified stock exchange under the Company Law Article 796(2). The exchange ratio was determined based on third-party valuations, considering Saikaya's earnings capacity, financial condition, real estate assets including the Yokosuka and Fujisawa stores, and market price.

The transaction is intended to facilitate integrated management of group resources, accelerate decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the financial foundation. Following the acquisition, AFC-HD plans to utilize Saikaya's real estate and other assets effectively while maintaining and strengthening Saikaya's departmentstore business operations and will explore future business structure and real estate utilization opportunities.
